  1                        SUPPLEMENTAL DIRECT TESTIMONY OF

 2                                         BRUCE L, JAMES

 3                                    I.    INTRODUCTION

 4     Q.   ARE YOU THE SAME BRUCE L. JAMES THAT GAVE PREVIOUS DIRECT

 5          TESTIMONY FILED ON MAY 10, 2026, AND SUPPLEMENTAL TESTIONY OF

 6          MAY 11, 2026?

 7     A.   Yes, I am.

 8     Q.   AFTER        READING     OTHER       INTERVENORS           DIRECT      AND     REBUTTAL

 9          TESTIMONY, ARE THERE OTHER CONCERNS YOU WHAT LIKE TO CALL

10          TO THE ALJ' S AND PUC' S ATTENTION?

11     A.   Yes, there are.

12                        II.   TRANSMISSION TOWER LIGHTING

13     Q.   WHAT IN YOUR BACKGROUND HAS RAISED THOSE CONCERNS?

14     A.   I hold a Commercial Pilot Certificate with multi-engine and instrument ratings as well as a

15          Lear Jet type rating. I have over 5,900 hours of flight time logged as a pilot. I have flown

16          in and out of Curtis Field in Brady, Texas many times in my flying career. I have also flown

17          over the Reata Ranch in both fixed wing and rotor aircraft on many occasions. We have

18          participated with the United States Army in the use ofour ranch along with the Quinn Ranch

19          (our cousins) in actual maneuvers on both sides ofthe San Saba River that included the use

20          of transport and attack type helicopters. Military helicopters fly over our ranch on a regular

21          basis, and we welcome them doing so. My dad, uncles, father-in law, all being veterans of

22          WWII, and now gone, would expect nothing less from our family in patriotic support of our

23          country.

24

     PUC DOCKET NO. 59475                          2                             2nd SUPP. DIRECT
     SOAHDOCKET 473-26-16346                                                       TESTIMONY OF
                                                                                 BRUCE L. JAMES
  1     Q.   WHAT SPECIFIC CONCERNS HAS YOUR BACKGROUND IN FLYING NOW

 2          RAISED?

 3     A.   We were told at the public meeting in Menard, Texas in 2025 that the transmission towers

 4          for the Oncor/LCRA 765kV project now at issue would be around 155 feet tall to as much

 5          as 180 feet tall.   If that is true, then those heights implicate FAA AC 70/7460-1M,

 6          "Obstruction Lighting and Marking."         As I read this Federal Aviation Administration

 7          Advisory Circular, all towers of the type proposed by Oncor/LCRA that are less than 150

 8          feet in height must have a double steady red light marking the top of the transmission tower

 9          operating at night and all transmission towers over 150 feet but less than 350 feet must have

10          a flashing red light at the rate of 30 fpm (flashes per minute) operating at night.

11     Q.   HOW WOULD THESE LIGHTED TRANSMISSION TOWERS AFFECT YOUR

12          RANCH USE AND ENJOYMENT?

13     A.    One ofour family's and friends' greatjoys on the Reata has been watching the stars, satellite

14          traffic, the International Space Station passing overhead at night, return of space shuttles,

15           and the billions of stars in the sky at night. I never saw anything like this when I lived in

16          Houston, San Antonio or Fort Worth. One of the darkest areas on our ranch is in the Double

17          M and 4-Way Pastures which are basically free of peripheral city and industrial lights. The

18           dark night sky of our Texas Hill Country ranch that so many people from around Texas

19           come to see for celestial events will be destroyed and is a treasured asset of ours. I fear the

20          Oncor/LCRA transmission towers will bring not only the ugliness of the structures

21          themselves but accompanying light pollution.         Having 4 or more transmission towers

22          proposed across our ranch alone with red lights blinking at the rate of 30 flashes per minute

23          will destroy this once treasured aspect of our ranch        The same will be true of all our

24          neighboring ranches that enjoy the same kind of outdoor adventures at night that we all have

     PUC DOCKET NO. 59475                           3                              2nd SUPP. DIRECT
     SOAHDOCKET 473-26-16346                                                         TESTIMONY OF
                                                                                   BRUCE L. JAMES
  1            enjoyed.

 2                                        III. CONCLUSION

 3     Q.     WHAT IS YOUR REQUEST TO THE COMMISSION?

 4     A.     We again respectfully ask the Commission to avoid approving any requested route

 5            suggested by Oncor/LCRA and particular any that includes or that uses Link M22. I know

 6            that the ranchers of McCulloch County represent what is good about our great State of

 7            Texas.     Texas can do much better than the current routing proposed that would surely

 8            adversely impact the rural citizen' s way of life and the San Saba River corridor. Is this

 9            really worth the destruction to our beautiful Hill Country?

10     Q.     DOES       THAT     CONCLUDE          YOUR     SECOND         SUPPLEMENTAL         DIRECT

11            TESTIMONY?

12     A.     Yes.
